## Rootcamp review request

- **Module/subject ID:**
- **Is this** ungraded exercise / graded module assessment / part capstone?
- **What I learned (in my own words):**
- **What changed and why:**
- **Evidence or screenshots (redacted):**
- **Known defects, uncertainties, and rabbit holes:**
- **Security boundary affected, if any:**
- **Tests performed and results:**
- **What feedback do I want?**

Reviewers: follow `.github/copilot-instructions.md`, especially the no-code-assistance policy before P3M3. Do not treat repository review as permission to run code, deploy or access credentials.
